How much does it cost to rent a limo in Scottsdale?

Scottsdale Sprinters rents limos for $150 to $295 an hour, chauffeured, with a 4-hour minimum on every limo: 4 hours in the classic Chrysler Limo is $600 before 8% Arizona sales tax ($648 with it), and 4 hours in the Pink Hummer Limo is $1,180. You rent the whole limo, not a seat, so a full cabin splits the total; stops, fuel and the chauffeur are included, and there is no booking fee or mileage charge. Below: prices for 2 hours, 4 hours, a night, a day, prom and a wedding, the per-person math, and what changes the price. Questions? Call (623) 986-6339 or email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

How much does it cost to rent a limo in Scottsdale?

Renting a limo in Scottsdale from Scottsdale Sprinters costs $150 to $295 an hour, with a 4-hour minimum on every limo, so the shortest hourly booking starts at $600 before tax in the Chrysler Limo ($648 with 8% Arizona sales tax); the price is the vehicle’s published hourly rate times your billable hours, with no per-mile charge, no booking fee and no fuel surcharge. By limo, per hour: the Chrysler Limo, our classic stretch for up to 8, is $150; the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) and the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) are $175 and $175; the one-of-one Pink Hummer Limo, for up to 18, is $295. The table below adds the Maybach, the Suburban, an Executive Sprinter and the party bus, so you can see what a limo is worth against each. You rent the whole vehicle, never a seat, so the total does not change with the headcount: 4 hours in the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) is $700 before tax whether ten ride or all 16. Split across every seat that is about $44 a person. Every figure on this page is computed from the same rate grid and pricing engine as checkout, so the number you read here is the number you pay, before the optional gratuity.

How much is a limo per hour?

A limo is $150 to $295 an hour here: $150 for the Chrysler Limo, $175 for a Limo Party Sprinter and $295 for the Pink Hummer Limo. The hourly rate covers the chauffeur, the fuel, every stop on your itinerary and bottled water on board. The hourly rate is the whole vehicle’s. Tax of 8% is added at checkout, and gratuity is optional and never added for you. Nothing else sits on the base fare: no service charge, no booking fee, no fuel surcharge and no charge per mile.

How much is it to rent a limo for 2 hours?

An hourly limo has a 4-hour minimum on every limo, so a two-hour night out books the minimum: $600 before tax in the Chrysler Limo and $700 in the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax). If you only need to get somewhere, a one-way ride is priced as a trip instead, with no hourly minimum: the Chrysler Limo is $350 one way, flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off, and priced from the drive beyond that, with the empty return included. Pick the hourly booking when the limo should wait for you: dinner, then a show, then the ride home, with the stops inside the hours. Pick the one-way ride for a single drop, such as a dinner or the airport. A return leg booked with it comes off 20%, and the quote shows the price before you pay. On a one-way ride or a round trip, an added stop is $50; on an hourly booking every stop is already included, because you have bought the time.

How much is a limo for 4 hours?

Four hours is the minimum on an hourly limo, and it is the most common booking: $600 in the Chrysler Limo, $700 in the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) and $1,180 in the Pink Hummer Limo, before 8% tax. With tax those are $648, $756 and $1,274. Four hours covers dinner and a few stops, or a prom from photos to the dance, or a concert with the ride home.

How much does it cost to rent a limo for a night?

A full night, pickup to the ride home, usually runs 6 hours: $900 before tax in the Chrysler Limo, $1,050 in the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) and $1,770 in the Pink Hummer Limo. Book 7 hours and one hour comes off automatically, so a 7-hour night bills 6 hours: $1,770 in the Pink Hummer Limo, the same fare as 6 hours. If the night might run long, booking the extra hour up front costs nothing more. In Old Town’s entertainment district, from 5 p.m. to 4 a.m. every night, hired vehicles load and unload only at the City’s marked Passenger Convenience Areas, so your chauffeur meets the group where the City allows it.

How much is it to rent a limo for a day?

A day in a limo is billed by the hour with free hours built in: book 7 to 11 hours and one is free, 12 to 14 hours and two are free, 15 hours or more and three are free. A 10-hour day bills 9 hours: $1,350 before tax in the Chrysler Limo and $1,575 in the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax). A 12-hour day, a wedding from getting ready to the send-off, bills 10 hours: $1,500 in the Chrysler Limo. The free hours come off at checkout on their own; there is no code to enter. For a day trip out of the Valley, the drive is part of the hours you book, and the chauffeur plans the route and the stops with you in writing before the day.

How much does a prom limo cost?

A prom limo is priced like any other hourly booking: 5 hours, from photos to the dance and home, is $750 before tax in the Chrysler Limo for up to 8, about $94 a person when every seat is filled, or $875 in the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) for up to 13, about $67 each. Every prom ride is alcohol-free: if anyone under 21 rides, no alcohol comes on the trip, and a parent or guardian contact can get pickup and drop-off updates. The prom night page has the full plan.

How much does a wedding limo cost?

A wedding limo for the couple is usually 4 hours, the minimum: $600 before tax in the Chrysler Limo, the classic black stretch for the exit, or $1,180 in the Maybach Jet Sprinter, our most luxurious ride. A Just Married sign, décor and a champagne toast are optional add-ons, each priced at checkout. The wedding party and the guests usually ride separately from the couple: an Executive Sprinter for the bridal party, a coach shuttle for the guests. The wedding transportation page plans the whole day, and the wedding shuttle bus guide sizes the guest loops.

Is a limo, a Sprinter or a party bus better value?

Per person, the bigger the cabin the lower each share: at the 4-hour minimum, before tax, the Party Bus (28 Pax) works out to about $36 a head, the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) about $44 and the Chrysler Limo about $75. Pick by the group and the night, then compare the total. A stretch limo is the silhouette: the long black car at the curb for prom, an anniversary or the wedding exit. A Limo Party Sprinter gives a bigger group the same limo seating with more room. The Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter is our best party ride and the Maybach Jet Sprinter our most luxurious; the Party Bus (28 Pax) is for the group past 16. The party bus cost guide prices every vehicle in the fleet the same way, and the comparison guide explains the difference between a party bus, a limo and a Sprinter in the cabin rather than the price.

What changes the price of a limo?

Five things move a limo’s price: the vehicle, the hours (never below the minimum), whether it is hourly or one way, the optional add-ons you choose, and the gratuity you choose to add. Tax is a fixed 8%. The number of riders and the miles driven on an hourly booking do not change it. Longer bookings cost less per hour, because free hours come off from 7 hours. Add-ons, from a red carpet to a Just Married sign or a photographer, are optional and priced at checkout before you pay; nothing is added for you. A 50% deposit holds the date and the balance is charged 48 hours before pickup. House-rule fees apply only if a rule is broken, such as $1,500 for smoking or vaping inside the vehicle.

Can you drink in a limo in Arizona?

Passengers 21 and over may bring their own alcohol on a for-hire limo in Arizona and drink on board; we do not sell it, the chauffeur never drinks, and if anyone under 21 rides, no alcohol comes on that trip. Arizona’s open-container law, A.R.S. § 4-251, carries an exception for passengers in a limousine used for hire; A.R.S. § 4-244 keeps every under-21 rule in force. There is no smoking, vaping or food inside any vehicle.

Frequently asked questions

How much is it to rent a limo?

At Scottsdale Sprinters a limo is $150 to $295 an hour with a 4-hour minimum on every limo, so an hourly limo starts at $600 before 8% tax in the Chrysler Limo. A one-way ride has no minimum and starts at $350.

How much does a limo cost per hour?

$150 an hour for the Chrysler Limo, $175 for a Limo Party Sprinter and $295 for the Pink Hummer Limo, with a 4-hour minimum on every limo. The rate includes the chauffeur, fuel, stops and bottled water.

How much is it to rent a limo for 2 hours?

An hourly limo books its 4-hour minimum, $600 before tax in the Chrysler Limo. For a single drop, a one-way ride has no minimum: $350 in the Chrysler Limo, flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off, with the empty return included beyond that.

How much is it to rent a limo for 4 hours?

$600 before tax in the Chrysler Limo, $700 in the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) and $1,180 in the Pink Hummer Limo. Arizona sales tax of 8% is added at checkout.

How much is it to rent a limo for a day?

A 10-hour day bills 9 hours because free hours come off automatically: $1,350 before tax in the Chrysler Limo. One hour is free from 7 hours, two from 12, three from 15.

How much is it to rent a limo for prom?

5 hours in the Chrysler Limo is $750 before tax, about $94 a person for 8 riders. Every prom ride is alcohol-free.

Do you pay per person or per limo?

Per limo. You rent the whole vehicle by the hour, so the total is the same with a full cabin or a half-empty one; the per-person figures on this page are that total split across every seat.

Are there hidden fees on a limo rental?

No. The fare is the hourly rate times your billable hours; Arizona sales tax of 8% is added at checkout. There is no booking fee, service charge, fuel surcharge or mileage charge, and gratuity is optional and never added for you.

How much do you tip a limo driver?

Gratuity is optional and never added automatically. If you choose to tip, add it at checkout or hand it to your chauffeur, and it goes to the chauffeur in full.

How much is the deposit for a limo?

A 50% deposit holds the date, and the balance is charged to the card on file 48 hours before pickup.

How far in advance should I book a limo?

Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Same-day bookings are welcome with no cutoff, subject to availability. Request a current quote for your date and we confirm in writing what is open.

Who drives, and is the company insured?

Every limo comes with a professional chauffeur who is background and MVR checked and drug screened, and the company is licensed and insured with commercial coverage on every vehicle. Guests give us a 5.0-star Google rating across 511 reviews.
